Which breakpoint catches which bug?

Know the line?

Use a line-of-code breakpoint.

Only some calls are wrong?

Use a conditional breakpoint.

Must not pause?

Use a logpoint.

When you do not know the line, break on the cause:

a fetch request, a DOM change, an event listener, or an exception.

At the pause, read Scope for the values

and the Call Stack for the callers.

Async frames show who started the wait.

The ignore list hides library frames.

The bug: render used a stale response.

The fix on line 6: return when q !== input.value.
